competition_title: Google - The Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition
submission_format: zip archive containing agent.yaml at root (submission.zip)
submission_budget: 12 hours aggregate limit across all tasks, inclusive of sandbox setup time, excluding patch validation
available_predefined_tools: read_file(filepath: str, start_line: int | None = None, end_line: int | None = None) -> str
edit_file(filepath: str, old_string: str, new_string: str, allow_multiple: bool = False) -> str
get_code_neighbors(node: str, edge_type: str | None = None, max_neighbors: int = 50) -> str
skill_constraints: Directories with SKILL.md manifest (name: <skill-name>); executed via run_skill_script in persistent Docker sandbox sharing filesystem with run_command; execution debited against central 12-hour budget; load_skill_resource for domain knowledge markdown inspection
adapter_format: PEFT LoRA .safetensors directories placed in adapters/<adapter_name>/ containing adapter_config.json and adapter_model.safetensors, referenced via adapter: <adapter_name> on any LlmAgent or AgentTool

hardware_environment.gpus: 4x NVIDIA L4 (24 GB GDDR6 per GPU, 96 GB total VRAM)

submission_constraints.single_base_model_rule: Strictly enforced: all agents in submission tree must declare the exact same base model

continuation_nudges.reset_condition: Turn with at least one tool call resets consecutive_nudges to 0
continuation_nudges.unclosed_tool_call_nudge: Injected when response reaches token limit before </tool_call> closes
continuation_nudges.max_tokens_nudge: Injected when response hits finish_reason MAX_TOKENS/LENGTH during thinking
continuation_nudges.normal_stop_nudge: Injected when agent emits text-only response without calling submit_patch

sandbox_environment.memory_limit: 4 GiB (killed with exit code 137 on exceed)
sandbox_environment.network_mode: none (completely air-gapped, zero external network/PyPI access)

notes.authentication_status: Kaggle API verified with KGAT_... bearer token at ~/.kaggle/access_token; competition rules accepted.
notes.dataset_download_status: Essential harness files (HARNESS_README.md, tasks.jsonl, docker/*, sandbox/setup.py, sample_submission/*, wheels_manifest.json) downloaded to data/competition/. Full 22 GB snapshot archive download can be staged on-demand per task or placed on D: partition (101 GB free) to conserve E: drive capacity.
notes.harness_libraries: swegemma (harness/scoring), adk-submission (declarative YAML compiler), adk-eval-core (task/result models, 3-tier resilient string replacement: exact -> flexible -> regex).
